title: Three-conveyor sequenced start (anti-pileup, two delays)
nl_spec: Three conveyors feed one another in series: C1 -> C2 -> C3 (C3 is the most downstream). To avoid pile-ups, on start they must come up most-downstream first: C3 starts, then C2 after PT_SEQ = 2 ticks, then C1 after a further PT_SEQ = 2 ticks. Model as a state machine: 0 = Off, 1 = C3 only, 2 = C3+C2, 3 = all three. StopPB or an activated emergency stop (EStop normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated) stops all three immediately. SAFETY-CRITICAL: C1 must never run unless C2 runs, and C2 must never run unless C3 runs. Use an internal INT State (0..3) and two TON timers. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named conveyor3 with inputs StartPB, StopPB, EStop and outputs C1, C2, C3.

interface.name: EStop
interface.description: Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated

safety_properties.nl: C1 never runs unless C2 runs.
C2 never runs unless C3 runs.
On emergency stop, all conveyors stop.
Whenever stop is pressed, all conveyors stop.

notes: Two staged delays; ordering invariants C1->C2 and C2->C3 are the safety-critical chain.
